# These are requirements the Ultimate Master Reference adds to, or restates with changed authority over,

column4: statement_en

Official identity is Sketch Design with the user-approved pencil + architectural plan mark, its distinctive lettering and the "PLANS. DRAWINGS. DESIGN." tagline; the retired parent brand must not be used.
Original vector artwork must be obtained for final production; raster concepts are not substitutes for master brand assets.

Design tokens: primary deep navy #0C1B38, action/focus cobalt #1258D9, surface off-white #FAFBFD with restrained blue-gray borders, warm gold accent used sparingly and never for primary controls. The reference labels these approximate.
Arabic-first RTL experience with a premium, calm architectural visual language and engineering-native interfaces.
Prohibited visual register: neon sci-fi, purple AI gradients, decorative bots, fabricated progress.
Launch as the operator's own service first; preserve tenant-aware contracts for a later managed B2B offering.
Institutions do not buy agent seats in the initial release; "Contact Sales" creates a lead and a managed onboarding process.
Individuals and engineers may self-register subject to verification rules.
Visible workflow is event-driven from actual server state across queued, validating, running, waiting-for-input, human-review, completed and failed.
No simulated progress and no invented time-to-completion may be displayed.
Every finding links to source evidence, an artifact, an agent execution and a reviewer disposition.
Frontend and Admin Console never invoke agent tools, provider keys or database tables directly.
Admin is a separate control interface; backend policies enforce authorization and change approvals.
Agent Runtime executes registered capabilities under a scoped task identity and a tool allowlist.
Model Gateway is a shared production service, not an agent and not a browser feature.
Knowledge retrieval is source-governed; code references require license, version, effective date and jurisdiction.
Data, object storage, vector retrieval, event logs and backups must respect project and tenant boundaries.

Core entity set is fixed: Tenant (reserved from day one), Organization, User, Role, Project, Site, Request, EvidencePackage, CaptureSession, Drawing, AgentDefinition, AgentVersion, WorkflowRun, TaskRun, ModelInvocation, Finding, ReviewDecision, Deliverable, AuditEvent, UsageRecord, Subscription/Entitlement (future).
Minimum API surface is nine named endpoints; the reference marks the contracts illustrative, so shapes are DESIGNED and require ratification before implementation.

An agent is a versioned capability bundle carrying purpose, input/output schemas, allowed tools, evidence policy, validation rules, escalation threshold, model policy, evaluation suite, cost/latency budget and rollback target.
Seven capability families each carry a named review boundary: Architecture, Structure, MEP, Cost/BOQ, Compliance, Evidence/Scan, Delivery/QA.
The villa golden workflow is a fixed ten-step sequence from intake and consent through versioned report and delivery.
Failed tasks can retry safely without duplicating billable side effects.
Agent version and provenance are pinned per workflow run; production promotion requires staged evaluation and human approval.
Typed inputs and outputs, JSON schema validation and source attribution are required for critical findings.
Tools run under least privilege with timeouts, quotas, cancellation and audit traces.
Circuit breakers, durable queues, dead-letter handling, idempotency keys and compensating actions are required.
Prompt injection defense is required at document and retrieval boundaries; untrusted files never change policies.
The legacy AI Core, local free-model assumptions and the old VPS stack are retired from the target architecture; a clean deployment is required.
Durable execution, usage ledger, cost accounting and fallback are preserved as new, independently tested services rather than reused implementations.
No named vendor or model is approved until procurement, data-policy and benchmark gates pass.

Routing sequence is fixed: task classification, sensitivity/residency gate, deterministic-tool eligibility, modality and Arabic proficiency, candidate allowlist, quality and latency SLO, price/capacity-aware choice, execution, output validation, approved fallback or human escalation.
Four provider tiers each carry an entry requirement: direct enterprise providers, approved aggregation gateway, deterministic engines, embedding/retrieval.
No silent routing to unapproved endpoints.

Six token-efficiency measures are mandated and must not degrade quality: task-scoped retrieval, versioned prompt caching, provenance-preserving compression, structured extraction over generative repetition, policy limits on loops and output size, and deduplication within an authorized project context.

Seven operations metric families are required: queue depth/age/wait p95; latency p50/p95/p99 and TTFT; requests per minute and tokens per second; 429/5xx/timeouts and fallback success; token and SAR cost by agent and project; eval pass, citation quality and review override; GPU/CPU/RAM/DB/storage.
Dashboard actions are enumerated, and all destructive or financial actions require explicit authorization and audit.
Mobile-responsive web camera first, with native LiDAR capture as an optional companion using RoomPlan/ARKit on supported iOS devices; universal browser LiDAR must not be promised.
Eight camera surface controls carry defined behavior: capture photo, video, live analysis, LiDAR scan handoff, measure, evidence list, privacy, offline/poor network.

The Evidence Package contract carries project ID, capture ID, device capability, modality, consent record, location precision policy, timestamp, file hashes, original media references, geometry representation, coordinate units, measurement confidence, quality flags, model/tool provenance, processing state and review state.
Camera-derived geometry is preliminary evidence; no structural assurance, permit compliance or certified dimensions may be issued solely from live camera output.
Founder, platform admin, security, support, engineering reviewer, finance and read-only auditor are separate roles.
The administrative capability matrix fixes eight capabilities against admin, support and reviewer roles.
Five operational playbooks are required: incident, maintenance, integration lifecycle, support privacy, SRE.

Commercial phasing is fixed at three phases; multi-tenant boundaries exist in the domain and authorization model now, while public self-service marketplace, full white-label builder and automated multi-tenant billing are deferred.
Five future B2B offers are defined: managed agent pack, monthly subscription, white-label hosted portal, embedded/API service, enterprise agreement.
No tenant cross-access in data, RAG, logs, cached prompts, tool actions, files or billing; branding does not grant control of platform security policies.
The delivery roadmap fixes eight stages, each with a named deliverable and exit evidence.
Seven release gates each require evidence and are listed explicitly.
The source register names six underlying sources and the decision ledger records the state of each decision.

Document governance is role-assigned: product owner approves changes, engineering leads own implementation evidence, security reviews data and provider policies, qualified engineers own professional sign-off.
Attached images are approved-direction visual concepts, not screenshots of a working platform.
Release requires no P0 security vulnerability and no unauthorized cross-project access.
Restore and rollback must be verified, not merely documented.
Saudi privacy, sectoral obligations, IP and code licensing must be reviewed by qualified counsel and experts.
